title: DMAIC-Bench: From Self-Reflection to Self-Restraint for Agents in Multi-Stage Analytical Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.32305v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-stage analytical tasks require LLM agents to use intermediate evidence to decide whether to continue, redirect or stop. Self-reflection, in which an agent critiques its output, is widely studied, yet a critique does not show whether evidence changed the next action. We call that capability self-restraint. Existing agent benchmarks largely measure task completion or output quality and leave it untested. DMAIC-Bench evaluates it with 97 seeded tasks across 15 industrial cases in four sectors, built around Lean Six Sigma's explicit statistical prerequisites. Paired counterfactual variants require opposite actions at the same workflow position, distinguishing warranted restraint from indiscriminate stopping. We assess execution traces with a private scorer and final claims through independent expert review. translated_title: DMAIC-Bench：多阶段分析任务中智能体从自我反思到自我克制
translated_abstract: 多阶段分析任务要求大语言模型智能体利用中间证据来决定是继续、转向还是停止。自我反思（即智能体批判自身输出的过程）已被广泛研究，然而批判本身并不能表明证据是否改变了下一步行动。我们将这种能力称为“自我克制”。现有的智能体基准测试主要衡量任务完成度或输出质量，而未对这一能力进行检验。DMAIC-Bench 通过 97 个种子任务来评估这一能力，这些任务覆盖四个行业的 15 个工业案例，并围绕精益六西格玛明确的统计学前提构建。成对的反事实变体要求智能体在同一工作流位置采取相反的行动，从而将有依据的克制与不加区分的停止区分开来。我们使用私有评分器评估执行轨迹，并通过独立专家评审评估最终结论。在对来自六家提供商的 13 个模型的评估中，执行层面的路由准确率在匹配的 GO 决策上平均为 92%，而在 NO-GO 决策上仅为 19%。
tldr: 该论文提出 DMAIC-Bench 基准，通过基于精益六西格玛的成对反事实任务首次系统评估大语言模型智能体的“自我克制”能力（即依据证据决定继续还是停止），发现模型在 GO 决策上准确率达 92%，但在 NO-GO 决策上仅约 19%。
en_tdlr: DMAIC-Bench introduces a benchmark of paired counterfactual tasks built on Lean Six Sigma to evaluate LLM agents' self-restraint—the ability to use evidence when deciding whether to continue or stop—revealing that models achieve 92% accuracy on GO decisions but only about 19% on NO-GO decisions.
